title: package.signature@1
description: A signed package's signature, beside package.envelope@1, whose frozen shape doesn't list it: the Ed25519 signature, by the envelope's publisher_key (ed25519:<64 lower-case hex of the raw public key>), of the RFC 8785 bytes of the envelope's id, version, digest and publisher_key. The package's digest leaves it out, as it leaves out the digest.

signature.description: The signature's 64 bytes in lower-case hex.
